exercises.why: **попался** — попа́сться (perfective): to get caught; (colloquial, impersonal) to come across, to chance upon, to meet. Wiktionary: попа́сть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to fall, to drop, to sink, to decline
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: пасть — (dated, literary) to fall; попа́сть — to hit (a target); упа́сть — to fall, to drop; па́дать — to fall, to drop, to sink, to decline.
**попались** — попа́сться (perfective): to get caught; (colloquial, impersonal) to come across, to chance upon, to meet. Wiktionary: попа́сть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **припадок** — припа́док: seizure; fit, paroxysm; attack (medicine: sudden onset of a disease); bout, turn. Wiktionary: припада́ть + -ок.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Tom had an attack of nerves.
exercises.why: **припадок** — припа́док: seizure; fit, paroxysm; attack (medicine: sudden onset of a disease); bout, turn. Wiktionary: припада́ть + -ок.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to abate, to fall (to decrease or become less in strength)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: спасть — to abate, to fall (to decrease or become less in strength); паде́ние — fall, collapse, drop, sinking; за́пад — west; попа́сться — to get caught.
**попадалась** — попада́ться (imperfective): to get caught; (colloquial, impersonal) to come across, to chance upon, to meet. Wiktionary: попада́ть + -ся.

exercises.why: **попадаться** — попада́ться (imperfective): to get caught; (colloquial, impersonal) to come across, to chance upon, to meet. Wiktionary: попада́ть + -ся.

exercises.q: What led the Soviet Union to break up?
exercises.why: **распаду** — распа́д: disintegration, breakup, collapse; (physics, chemistry) decay, dissociation.
